title: fix(platform-objects): no-mail invite outcome states the verified-address rule; Import Users says "Already pending"

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:未配置邮件的部署上,邀请用户与重新发送邀请的结果提示不再叫管理员去用「复制邀请链接」,改为说明规则:接受邀请需要已验证邮箱,无邮件时只有通过社交或 SSO 登录且地址被验证的受邀人能接受,其他人由平台管理员直接建账号;导入用户结果里 `alreadyPending` 的统计与列标题从「Already pending, told again」改为「Already pending」。十种语言翻译同步。
- 为什么改:#34883 落地后未验证邮箱不能接受邀请,旧提示把管理员引向一条走不通的路;被停用的待激活人员重新导入时并未通知托管组织,旧标题却写「已再次通知」,与旁边「Why not told: deactivated」矛盾。
- 风险与回滚:只改文案与列标题,无行为、接口或数据变化;回滚即回退本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/invite-outcome-messages.ts`(两条 `link_only` 文案)、`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`(`import_sso_users` 结果的两个标题)、`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.objects.generated.ts`(译文样本)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/identity/invitation-delivery-copy.test.ts src/identity/cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts`,预期两个文件全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **#34889, no-mail invite outcome.** `INVITE_USER_OUTCOME_MESSAGES.link_only` (the four `invite_user` mirrors: Users, Members, Invitations, the organization page) and `RESEND_INVITATION_OUTCOME_MESSAGES.link_only` stop telling the admin to "Use Copy Invite Link on the invitation to share it." Accepting, declining and listing an invitation need a verified address, so on a deployment without live mail a copied link admits the sign-up and nothing more. The copy now states the rule, the one exception (an invitee whose social or SSO sign-in verifies the address) and the operator path (a platform administrator creates the account), matching `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`. The file header records the rule; a comment on `sys_invitation.copy_invitation_link` says what the link admits. No behaviour change: the outcome, the action and Copy Invite Link behave as before.
- **#35164, Import Users labels.** `sys_user.import_sso_users`'s `summary.alreadyPending` field and `alreadyPending` column read "Already pending" instead of "Already pending, told again", as Add User's `pendingAgain` already does. A deactivated pending person is re-added with `host.notified: false, reason: 'deactivated'`; whether the host was told stays the "Hosting organization told" and "Why not told" columns' answer.
- **Translations.** `en` regenerated from the source with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`; the ten translated locales carry hand-written translations of the new leaves (the generator keeps translated values; AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails).
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/34889-identity-outcome-copy.md`, `patch` on `@objectstack/platform-objects`.
- **The released 18.5.0 CHANGELOG sentence** (comment 6974439913 on #35164) is amended in its own docs-only PR, `claude/issue-35164-changelog-18-5-0`, because AGENTS.md makes `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` release-owned: never edited in a code PR.

## Tests

- `invitation-delivery-copy.test.ts`: the `link_only` copy of `invite_user` and `resend_invitation` does not contain the Copy Invite Link label, in English and in each translated bundle's own label for every mirror.
- `cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts`: `import_sso_users` labels `summary.alreadyPending` and the `alreadyPending` column "Already pending", and the host column keeps "told".
- Ablation, one per new assertion (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proven on disk, restore proven by blob and empty `git diff HEAD`): putting the old "Use Copy Invite Link" sentence back into both `link_only` copies turns the 2 new `link_only` cases red (2 failed / 38 passed); putting "Already pending, told again" back on the column turns the label case red (1 failed / 62 passed). The pre-change bundles at `cdb327fd` hold each locale's translated label 6 times (the label plus the five `link_only` copies), so the translated leg was red on them too.

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.inviteOutcome-27797.test.tsx` keeps its own fixture copy of the old `link_only` tail (`LINK_ONLY_TAIL`). It is a test-local fixture that feeds the console a declared message and asserts the toast relays it; it does not read the producer, so it stays green and is not a pin on this text. Noted, not changed (outside this card's file surface).
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ux-conventions.json` (the invite-outcome regression row) quotes the old `link_only` sentence verbatim as the expected toast. A checklist run of that row on a no-mail deployment will now read the new text. Noted for the checklist owner, not changed here (outside this card's file surface).
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx` names Copy Invite Link for the expired-invitation gate, which is still true; left as released. `self-hosting.mdx` already states the rule and the operator path; unchanged.
- "told again" elsewhere: `plugin-auth/src/auth-route-ledger.ts` describes the add-sso-user route's behaviour ("the host is told again, unless the person is deactivated"), which is accurate and does not quote this label; the plugin-audit mention test, a cli test and a ui data test use the phrase in unrelated senses.
